engine: Springs '3/9/10/16' pinned STAT-CARD slider — one pinned scroll steps through N data points; each step fires FOUR different mechanics at once. Harvested from D_springs_walkthrough_video (S11).

measured_teardown.steps: 4 (3 min walk to park / 9 to embankment / 10 by car to MIBC / 16 by car to MIBC). Pinned right card ~310px.

per_step_mechanics.1_bg: full-bleed atmospheric photo (matched to the stat) swaps by VERTICAL SLIDE-UP — next rises from the bottom pushing the old up (f_140: water strip enters at bottom while card still reads 3).
per_step_mechanics.2_card_photo: square photo tile inside the card CROSSFADES to the new image.
per_step_mechanics.3_numeral: giant serif numeral changes via ODOMETER ROLL (f_151 catches 9->10 mid-roll: digit translating vertically with a brand accent panel wiping up behind it).
per_step_mechanics.4_label: all-caps caption SWAPS (crossfade; mid-transition garble at f_142/f_145 = a text-swap crossfade, not a hard cut).

measured_teardown.extras: thin PROGRESS BAR on the card edge (gold/green); the section PINS; SNAP to each step.
measured_teardown.luxury: four data points choreographed as a cinematic — each changing together but via DIFFERENT mechanics (bg=slide, photo=crossfade, numeral=roll, label=swap).

snap.what: snap to each step (snapTo 1/(N-1), duration 0.3, power1.inOut).

manageLenis.what: create+drive a Lenis instance (false if the page owns one).

render_model.fpos: prog * (N-1) = fractional step index; i = floor, f = within-step 0..1.
render_model.bg: layer<i -> translateY(-100%); layer i -> -100%*f; layer i+1 -> 100%*(1-f); >i+1 -> 100%.
render_model.photo: layer i opacity 1 (under); layer i+1 opacity = f (fades in on top); rest 0.
render_model.numeral: the .so-num-col translates translateY(-(i+f)*numHeight) so the active number sits in the .so-num-window (height MUST equal one numeral height).
render_model.label: text = nearer step's label; opacity = |f-0.5|*2 (dips to 0 at mid = the swap).

entry: StatOdometer.init(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, render, steps, refresh, destroy }. Markup-first: .so-step children carry data-num/data-label/data-bg/data-photo; the engine builds the bg stack, card-photo stack, numeral column, label, progress.
law: Lenis 1.1.13 -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update; lagSmoothing(0); render(prog) PURE fn; pin/pinSpacing/scrub:true + snap; transform (bg slide, numeral roll) + opacity (photo crossfade, label swap) ONLY; bg/photo are real (object-fit:cover) so they composite as solid media; GPU layers; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the scrubbed surface; NO WebGL; reduced-motion / <=820px -> static stacked list.
gate_mode: CURTAIN/SLICER (CURTAIN=1): the bg slide-up shows two solid renders during the step transition = the technique (coSolid/seam expected); blank/jank/fps stay hard. (Learned: bg/photo MUST be , not background-image — the gate's solid-media check looks for an ; background-image read as blank 100%.)
proven: lab rebuilds the engine on OUR data: 4 QUADRO distances (3 пішки до парку / 7 до набережної / 12 авто до центру / 20 до аеропорту), our renders in the bg + card tiles, Ukrainian labels. Gate (CURTAIN mode) PASS: 0 blank, 59.9fps, jank 1/725. Mid-step verified: bg slide (-808/92), photo crossfade (1/0.89), numeral roll, label swap (op 0.79), progress 0.63 — all four firing on one step.
